name: Firearm Catastrophe
description: A natural 1 on a firearm attack (except Silent Mechanism weapons): roll a d6.

results.name: The weapon is damaged and unusable until repaired.
results.description: The weapon is damaged and unusable until repaired.

results.name: It backfires, dealing half its listed damage (non-exploding) to the wielder.
results.description: It backfires, dealing half its listed damage (non-exploding) to the wielder.

results.name: It explodes: full listed damage (exploding dice apply) to the wielder and any creature within 5ft.
results.description: It explodes: full listed damage (exploding dice apply) to the wielder and any creature within 5ft.
